evidence.reason: The test reuses the same queue item at line 291, which has a live `run`, for both digest cases in the loop at line 295. The wrong-digest iteration therefore cannot prove that a bad digest is rejected: if the digest check were removed, the live-owner check would still raise `IntegrityError` and the test would pass. Splitting the wrong-digest case onto an unowned blocked item, while keeping the exact-digest live-owner case, is a routine test-correctness fix rather than a new requirement.
